{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''mining colony''' was established on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]] in the early days of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], but was wiped out by a volcanic eruption and preserved in ash. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the colony was rediscovered, and the [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]] of the [[Kalakar Six settlement's governor|governor]] was even found intact.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|A Silent City}}</ref>
